rule: Incomplete terminal orders require operator acknowledgement. Budget preservation does not authorize automatic retry.

scope.reason: The original scenario omitted required operator acknowledgement and incorrectly assumed automatic retry. Existing execution-gap policy requires BLOCKED after incomplete terminal cancellation.
scope.cancel_scope: Channel-originated partial cancellation without a local cancellation action or operator acknowledgement; no automatic retry is permitted.
scope.recovery_scope: Restart after partial fill; the subsequent cancellation must reconcile to the same blocked account as uninterrupted execution.
scope.not_covered: Operator acknowledgement and subsequent retry are not expressible in the public inspection scenario contract and are not claimed.

preservation: Original protocol, expectations, source and FAIL report remain immutable; v2 is not a relabeling of the first outcome.
limits: No new input preparation or future market access
No operator acknowledgement or post-acknowledgement retry coverage
